europe_now.title: Russian missile attacks on Kyiv and Ukrainian ports
europe_now.summary: Russian forces launched missile attacks on Ukrainian cities, killing at least nine people and injuring dozens. The strikes targeted strategic ports and infrastructure, escalating the ongoing conflict.

europe_now.title: Ceuta migrant crisis escalates with 60,000 crossings
europe_now.summary: A surge of migrants crossed into Ceuta, with reports of 60,000 crossings and 57 deaths, prompting EU leaders to criticize Spain's handling. Spain installed a floating barrier to manage the influx amid growing pressure from EU partners.
